title: An anonymous caller can read files outside the export directory
summary: An export request can return files belonging to the server when the caller chooses a parent path.
rootCause: The export handler joins a caller-controlled path without checking the resolved directory.

steps: Send a parent-directory filename to the export route.
The handler resolves the path outside the export directory.
The response returns the selected server file.
assumptions: The server account can read the selected file.

severity.rationale: Server configuration files may contain credentials usable against other services.

validation.summary: Inspected path construction and file response; no runtime test was performed.

remediation.summary: Resolve the requested path and require it to remain inside the export directory.
regressionTests: Reject parent-directory and absolute-path export requests.

counterEvidence: A reverse proxy might reject traversal sequences.

codeEvidence.label: File read
codeEvidence.explanation: The joined path reaches the file response.
